title: I-30 Dallas Downtown Canyon Construction
text: In February 2025 TxDOT awarded a $888.7 million contract to Balfour Beatty Infrastructure for reconstruction of the downtown Canyon. The first noticable work began on January 17, 2026, when multiple bridges including Cesar Chavez (originally Central Expressway) were demolished. More bridges were demolished on the weekend of January 31, 2026.

images.caption: This view looks east from the Griffin bridge. The Cadiz and Akard bridges, previously ahead in the photo, were demolished in January 2026.
Cadiz Street is blocked after the bridge removal.

This view looks across the freeway at the location of the Cadiz Street bridge. The footings for the bridge beams are visible on the far side of the freeway. As this photo shows, the drop-off at the bridge location was poorly secured.
This view looks east from South Saint Paul.
This view looks east at the location of the Cesar Chavez bridges, which were demolished on the weekend of January 17, 2026.
This view looks south from the north side of I-30 at Cesar Chavez. It shows the northbound lanes of Cesar Chavez after the bridges were removed.
This view looks south from the north side of I-30 at Cesar Chavez, showing the site of the northbound bridges which connected to Cesar Chavez.
The edge of the pavement after removal of the bridges.
